title: TradeGauntlet: Evaluating Compliance Controls for Autonomous Trading Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.18493v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous trading agents need controls that prevent problematic orders without making legitimate tasks impractical. We study this aspect of agentic compliance with TradeGauntlet, a replayable limit-order-book simulator that separates detection, prevention, and execution cost. In 1,680 simulated sessions with Claude Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, all conduct alerts were self-matches. Gates eliminated those alerts by rejecting self-crossing orders, while the aggregate-gate condition reduced Sonnet's two-sided fills by about 15%. A conduct reminder reduced Sonnet's alert rate but reduced Haiku's fills without a detectable alert benefit. These results show why zero alerts alone do not establish an agent's compliance. Scripted probes and two search methods test weaknesses beyond those observed in the LLM runs. translated_title: TradeGauntlet：评估自主交易代理的合规控制
translated_abstract: 自主交易代理需要能够防止问题订单、同时又不至于让合法任务变得难以执行的控制机制。我们通过 TradeGauntlet 研究智能体合规的这一方面——这是一个可回放的限价订单簿模拟器，将检测、预防和执行成本三者分离。在使用 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 Sonnet 5.5 进行的 1,680 次模拟会话中，所有行为警报均为自成交。门控机制通过拒绝自交叉订单消除了这些警报，而聚合门控条件使 Sonnet 的双边成交减少了约 15%。行为提醒降低了 Sonnet 的警报率，但在没有可检测到的警报收益的情况下降低了 Haiku 的成交量。这些结果表明，仅凭零警报不足以确立智能体的合规性。脚本化探针和两种搜索方法用于测试大模型运行中未观察到的弱点。搜索发现了能够规避已实现行为规则的拆分订单计划；一个学习得到的基线捕获了全部 2,400 个经过测试的搜索样本。
tldr: 论文提出 TradeGauntlet——一个可回放的限价订单簿模拟器，用于评估自主交易代理的合规控制，结果表明仅凭零警报不足以证明智能体合规，且对抗性搜索能发现规避现有行为规则的拆分订单策略。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces TradeGauntlet, a replayable limit-order-book simulator for evaluating compliance controls of autonomous trading agents, showing that zero alerts alone do not establish agent compliance, as adversarial searches can discover split-order schedules that evade existing conduct rules.
